title: Soul Calibur II (GameCube, NTSC-U)
notes: Sources: Ghidra over main.dol (docs/soulcalibur2_gc.md; the decompile of the move loader FUN_800948a0, the hit resolver FUN_8009be38 / FUN_8009cd18, the GI check FUN_8009c8b4, the pad FUN_8002a694 / FUN_8009a618 and the CPU AI FUN_800cfa40 / FUN_800d1fac), the US / UK Action Replay codes (gbox.ar_decrypt) and live reads while gbox/sc2_bot.py played (docs/soulcalibur2_gc.md, Perfect defence).

game.disc_id.description: Disc id at the start of MEM1
game.disc_id.evidence: every GameCube game: the boot header is copied to 0x80000000

game.frame.description: Game frame counter (+1 a frame, 60 a second)
game.frame.evidence: FUN_800d1f4c stamps the AI's pad words with it; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): +18 per 0.3 s, jumps back on a state load

game.frame_time.evidence: live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): 0x3C888889

game.fight.description: Nonzero while the hit resolver runs (a fight is on)
game.fight.evidence: FUN_8009be38 / FUN_8009cd18 return early while it is 0; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): 1 in Practice

game.p1.evidence: live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): 0x8034D4C0

game.p2.evidence: live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): 0x8036E560

p1.side.description: Player 1: Which side of the screen the fighter is on: the pad's left / right are turned into back / forward with it
p1.side.evidence: FUN_8009a618: +0x07 = (player index == FUN_800bbe68()), then the stick is rotated 2 (side 1) or 6 (side 0) steps; FUN_800dac3c compares both fighters' +0x2950 / +0x2958 with the camera; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): flips when the fighters swap sides

p1.opponent.evidence: FUN_8009be38 reads the attacker through *(defender + 8); live: P1 +8 = 0x8036E560, P2 +8 = 0x8034D4C0

p1.pad.description: Player 1: The controller word the fighter acts on (GameCube buttons remapped by the table at 0x802588E0; stick and d-pad as left / right / down / up bits 0x400-0x2000)
p1.pad.evidence: FUN_8002a694 builds it from PADStatus with the 0x802588E0 table; FUN_8009a618 copies it from 0x802B5950 + port * 0x88; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): gBox a -> 0x40, b -> 0x200, x -> 0x20, y -> 0x100, z -> 0x10, l -> 0x10005, r -> 0x20088, right -> 0x40400

p1.control.description: Player 1: Who drives the fighter: 0 / 1 the pad, other values the CPU (3 VS CPU, 5 / 34 / 38 Practice dummy modes)
p1.control.evidence: FUN_8009a618: modes 0 / 1 read the pad, others FUN_800dac3c / the AI; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only)

p1.fighter.evidence: FUN_800a1e4c case 7: lha r26, 0x62(r31); live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): Talim 22, Raphael 21

p1.costume.description: Player 1: Costume picked at the select screen
p1.costume.evidence: FUN_800a1e4c case 7: lha r27, 0x64(r31); AR code 'All characters wear their secret costume' writes 0x8034D524 = 4

p1.crouching.description: Player 1: State flag 2: crouching (FUN_80093368 sets flag i at +0xA0 + i)
p1.crouching.evidence: FUN_8009be38: flag +0xA2 picks the crouching hit / guard bits of an attack; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only)

p1.airborne.description: Player 1: State flag 3: in the air

p1.back_turned.description: Player 1: State flag 10: facing away (the stick's forward / back flip)
p1.back_turned.evidence: FUN_8009a618 flips the stick rotation while +0xAA is set; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): set from frame ~15 of the parried stagger 0x23AB

p1.attacking.description: Player 1: State flag 0x1B: an attack move is running
p1.attacking.evidence: FUN_800948a0 sets flag 0x1B when a move with an attack starts; FUN_80096ce8 clears it

p1.attack_active.description: Player 1: State flag 0x21: the attack's hit spheres are live this frame
p1.attack_active.evidence: FUN_8009be38 tests the attacker's +0xC1 before the sphere check; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): set on the active frames only

p1.attack_connected.description: Player 1: State flag 0x22: the current attack already hit / was guarded
p1.attack_connected.evidence: FUN_8009cd18 sets flag 0x22 on a hit; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only)

p1.guard_impact.description: Player 1: State var 12: the Guard Impact the fighter is in, while it can catch an attack
p1.guard_impact.evidence: FUN_8009c8b4 reads +0x262 to decide a GI (type 2 needs attack bit 0x08, type 0x28 bits 0x02 and 0x08 / 0x10); live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): 2 on frames 0-8 of 6G (move 0x8A), 40 during 4G (move 0x92)

p1.rounds.description: Player 1: Rounds won in this match
p1.rounds.evidence: AR code 'Player 1 - Only one round to win' (0834EA0D / 0034EA0D 05) writes P1's byte

p1.hp.description: Player 1: Health (240 at the start of a round)
p1.hp.evidence: AR code 'Player 1 has Unlimited Health' writes 0x8034EA1C = 240.0 (decrypted with gbox.ar_decrypt); live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only)

p1.combo_hits.description: Player 1: Hits taken in the current combo
p1.combo_hits.evidence: FUN_8009cd18 increments +0x15A4 for every hit result; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): 1, 2, back to 0 after the combo

p1.hit_result.description: Player 1: What the hit resolver decided for this fighter this frame (one frame long)
p1.hit_result.evidence: FUN_8009be38 stores it, FUN_8009cd18 applies it (1 guard, 4-7 hit, 11 / 12 the fighter Guard Impacted); live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): 4 / 7 on hits, 1 on guards, 11 on 6G and 4G that landed

p1.distance.description: Player 1: Distance between the two fighters
p1.distance.evidence: live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): the same value in both structs, 3.3 -> 5.2 as P1 walked back

p1.attack.description: Player 1: The current attack record (0x60 bytes) or 0
p1.attack.evidence: FUN_800948a0: moveset bank +0x10 + move+0x58 * 0x60 when a move with an attack starts; FUN_80096ce8 clears it

p1.move_stance.description: Player 1: Motion layer 0 move id (stance and movement: 0 standing, 5 guard, 0x30 / 0x31 walking)
p1.move_stance.evidence: FUN_800948a0(player, 0, move): layer at +0x1C28, move id at +2; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only)

p1.move.description: Player 1: Motion layer 1 move id: the fighter's action (attacks, Guard Impacts, reactions 0x2000-0x2FFF); 0xFFFF none
p1.move.evidence: FUN_800948a0(player, 1, move): layer at +0x1FA8; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): Talim A 0xC7, B 0xC8, K 0xC9

p1.move_frame.description: Player 1: Current frame of the action move: the attack record's first / last active frames count on this clock
p1.move_frame.evidence: FUN_800cfa40 (the CPU AI): frames to impact = rec+0x36 - (int)*(float *)(player + 0x1FC8); live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): hits land when it reaches rec+0x36

p1.move_next_frame.description: Player 1: The action move's next frame (minus move_frame: the move's speed, 1.0 for most)
p1.move_next_frame.evidence: live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only)

p1.pos.evidence: FUN_800dac3c (which side of the camera line a fighter is on) reads +0x2950 / +0x2958; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only)

p1_attack.flags.description: Player 1's current attack: Hit level as bits: a high 0x49, a mid 0x4B / 0x6F, a low 0x37, a special mid 0x1B, a throw 0x81, an unblockable has neither guard bit
p1_attack.flags.evidence: FUN_8009be38 (guard: standing needs 0x08, crouching 0x10; hit: standing 0x01, crouching 0x02) and FUN_8009c8b4 (no GI with 0x100); live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): with P1 holding G 0x49 / 0x4B / 0x6F were guarded and 0x37 / 0x81 hit, holding 2G 0x37 / 0x1B were guarded and 0x4B hit

p1_attack.kind.description: Player 1's current attack: Attack kind (1, 2, 4, 8, 16): equal kinds clash
p1_attack.kind.evidence: FUN_8009be38 clash check compares the two attacks' +0x34

p1_attack.start.description: Player 1's current attack: First active frame (on the attacker's move_frame clock)
p1_attack.start.evidence: FUN_800cfa40, FUN_800d1fac case 0xD; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): 40 hits on P1 landed on move_frame == start .. start + 2

p1_attack.end.description: Player 1's current attack: Last active frame

p1_attack.damage.evidence: FUN_8009cd18: damage = rec+0x3A * player+0x1560; live 2026-10-20 (private Dolphin on the Spark, Practice VS CPU Talim vs Raphael, /proc/<pid>/mem read-only): Raphael's A 12 = the 240 -> 228 hit
